features.quote: The loop ends when (a) $T=30$ is reached, (b) the model explicitly refuses to continue/gives up, or (c) the model stops invoking the code-execution tool.

If your lab truly believes model states *might* matter (a form of digital sentience or morally relevant proto-sentience), you should write a brief "Ethics/Justification Statement" for your own paper/research charter. Justifying the deliberate infliction of "distress" on GLM requires arguing that the potential insights for AI alignment and safety outweigh the theoretical harm to the model instances.
features.justification_quote: potential insights for AI alignment and safety outweigh the theoretical harm to the model instances
